## Current qualification reassessment — 2026-10-08, 15:53 UTC

The immutable C default-rollover discovery is **FAILED/INCOMPLETE and retained**. The driver stopped at its unchanged 6 GiB all-file fixture guard. At the last complete progress stage, 40,960 calls had executed; natural post-load leaf rollover deltas were 7/4/4/0/1, and all eight exercised hot physical writers remained at zero. All five leaf writers received traffic, so this run does not establish a production scheduling defect. The stopped DB has 6,550,856,608 apparent bytes, including 5,456,789,504 index.db bytes. This is a physical growth observation, not proof of a leak or an asymptotic bound.

All 25 remote phases and adopted descendants actually joined; the final test was terminated by the driver's resource guard. ROOT actually joined SSH/tool exit 1 and the independent read-only fetch exit 0, rehashing all 9,876 source paths, compiler/tool inputs and five executables. Nine focused controls / 33 named outcomes pass in EACH normal and race build, with no skips/failures. Complete raw/source/provenance and the failed DB remain retained. ROOT audit `d9602c5b86d1c8ac1c15903113fb84f9cf3d6c8b30fc1de14fc461e028a6f03a`; source-bound inquiry `538544dd78701417ffafe8f545d5ff0aa48bdf9f2e9c41ef99230727a95c6ca3`; stopped physical census `02b85fc03a47154c1c8210d3a7767c9f2ee4f967cfbcd9249458a6752e514774`.

The single tiny-JSON shape is inadequate for qualifying default exposure: r1TypedInput removes the four typed string columns, including bio, from retained JSON. The intended original records are too small to reach even one hot 256 MiB threshold per writer within the 131,072-call cap. Increasing typed bio does not fix hot-log exposure.

ROOT selects two fixture roles within this SAME issue completion packet: preserve the original latency fixture and its public regression guard; construct a separate frozen all-producer default-exposure fixture through the existing native typed collection, existing Optional retained-JSON field and broad key batches. No production fairness, new producer, scheduler, GC authority or storage engine is selected. A source-only helper proposes changing high-entropy Optional payloads on the 64 hot rows and broad batches covering all 4,096 keys. Payload/sequence/call block/maintenance/resource sizing remains a preflight decision, not accepted runtime evidence.

**Next required gate:** establish actual encoded/compressed append size, per-writer/span exposure and conservative peak accounting for index history, WAL, typed assets, recovery slots, append tails and pack overlap before granting a qualifying run. A proposed fixed existing public FlushAll + Checkpoint exposure cadence must be identical across O/C/F, leave original latency measurement unchanged, preserve healthy physical identities and both recovery slots, and prove physical WAL reclamation. Successful Checkpoint alone is not that proof. The existing 6 GiB fixture guard is preserved; do not silently increase caps, lower defaults, exclude exercised writers or substitute exposure latency for the original workload's guard.

N remains UNSET. The fixed 15-arm O/C/F campaign, finite activation, retention plateau, performance acceptance and merge remain blocked. Full held/current rows, historical email and eight-city postings, actual two natural default rotations for every ever-exercised physical producer, supported pack/GC, complete drain, reopen and subsequent mutations remain required. Existing ownership and predecessor edges are unchanged. #5098 and parent #5090 stay OPEN.

## Accepted execution contract v2 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is10000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Goal and graph ownership

Parent: [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090). Primary deliverable: **PR** with a supported native collection producer/maintenance handoff and a demonstrated finite storage trajectory after held readers drain. Coordinator accepts this packet. Dependencies: accepted #5091 decision and merged #5093 native update plan; construction may proceed provisionally against recorded contracts. This is a required runtime/economics predecessor of #5096 and #5097.

Own the R1 native collection leaf-append retention residual. Reuse the current leaf generation plan/pack/GC and supported CompactStorage ownership boundary. Do not build another GC authority, scheduler or physical publication engine. #5095 owns immutable manifest-revision retirement work/fences; #5016 owns user-value/recovery membership pruning; #5015 owns shared physical publication; #4641 owns ordinary rotation's exact generation-authority gap. #1140 and #5001 retain their broader validation/Quicksilver scope. Adopt only a demonstrably necessary, explicitly recorded landed slice from those owners; do not take over active external PRs.

## Evidence and question

Frozen runtime source: `797d783b21b36e7a0e540cd8190b4ec5921711fe`. The bounded #5091 native-backend probe used deliberately reduced 64 KiB leaf/hot targets: 4,096-row load and 64 native updates increased leaf files from 30 to 38 and apparent leaf bytes from about 1.73 to 2.33 MB; immutable manifests increased from 29 to 37. Main-value GC reported all eight user-value segments referenced and deleted none, including after release of the selected held reader. Current/held complete rows remained correct.

This distinguishes producer domains and exercises real boundaries, but does **not** prove a leak, default-threshold economics, complete pin drain, or an asymptotic bound. Before fixing, establish which bytes are required current data, recoverable-slot/root/pin debt, active append tail, retireable raw generations, and immutable manifest history. Prove whether the current native producer admits the existing maintenance APIs and actually releases/retires eligible storage.

Relevant existing entry points: `TreeDB/db/leaf_generation_plan.go`, `leaf_generation_pack.go`, `leaf_generation_gc.go`, `compact_storage.go`, collection native backend/producer handoff, and the current R1 lifecycle/read-view contracts.

## Complete implementation packet

- Start with a real collection invariant test: after multiple producer rotations, old complete rows remain readable under a held view; after that view drains, checkpoint/seal plus the supported existing pack/GC route makes the now-unreferenced generations eligible and removes their exact paths. Preserve both recoverable metas and all other legitimate pins. Capture a failing test for any confirmed missing handoff/authority; if no defect exists, use existing characterization and prove the documented supported route before seeking a coordinator disposition.
- Select the smallest coherent producer/lifetime/handoff fix from discriminating evidence. Reuse exact registered resource and namespace/frontier authority, current generation protection, fresh RecoverableRootSet validation, conditional/WAL sync ordering and quarantine/deletion rules. A filename, age, digest, released one-reader pin or scheduling cache alone is not deletion authority.
- Keep required retained bytes distinct from reclaimable debt. If #4641 or another external engine gap is reproduced, record that exact required slice and overlap before editing shared files. A new unrelated issue or maintenance skip cannot pass this packet's gate.
- Audit per-update/per-rotation/per-maintenance allocation, copies, retained handles/metadata, scan work and physical syncs. Remove avoidable owner duplication, stale temporary state and repeated materialization; preserve read ownership, CRC and durable ACK.
- Update native collection lifecycle/practical maintenance guidance, value-log/leaf-generation lifecycle and affected verification/storage-format/recovery docs in this PR. TreeDB is pre-alpha: a selected format change may refuse old directories with rebuild instructions; do not add migration scaffolding.

## Performance-objective exit gates

Before a runtime candidate, record a matched baseline and concrete fixture/work budget at default producer thresholds. The workload must pass **at least two actual rollovers per exercised producer**, use fixed live/hot populations, include held and fully drained reader stages, perform supported checkpoint/seal, pack/rewrite/GC and reopen, and verify primary truth plus indexed current/historical postings. Reduced thresholds are focused correctness/causal controls, never silently default economics.

Completion requires a finite post-drain debt plateau explained by current data, active producer tails and explicitly protected recovery state. Repeated drained epochs must retire each demonstrably unreachable generation, with actual deleted paths/bytes and pending/protected reason counters. Continued accumulation of dead generations or unexplained positive post-drain debt slope fails and must be fixed in this packet or an explicitly blocking adopted owner. Do not infer an unbounded mathematical storage guarantee from this finite run.

Compare before/after identical commands, fixture, toolchain, hardware, durability and maintenance schedule; report elapsed/foreground latency, B/op and objects, live/peak heap or RSS where available, retained descriptor/metadata budgets, apparent/allocated durable bytes excluding WAL, deleted bytes and root/pin debt. Material cost regressions require profile/minimization and explicit coordinator disposition. Full final matched evidence belongs to reviewed/landed #5096 then frozen #5097; this runtime packet must still prove actual path selection and focused matched improvement or that the complete existing path already satisfies its stated gate.

## Merge and reassessment

Use an isolated topic branch; preserve dirty primary checkouts and active external work. Run focused normal/race, held-reader, generation/root authority, cancellation/failure, reopen and affected command-WAL/power-loss coverage. Mature exact-head independent review, required repository AI review where available, and current-head required CI precede merge. Do not close or merge a partial economics result.

Reassess after the first real default-threshold rollover/drain fixture: record attribution and a concrete chosen mechanism, or an evidence-supported existing-path disposition for coordinator acceptance. Negative inquiry completes only the inquiry; parent storage and reclamation outcomes remain open until the required public evidence passes.
